interventionCandidates.barrier: No invite prompt at the first-project moment, so setup ends solo
interventionCandidates.title: Invite prompt at first-project creation
interventionCandidates.description: The moment a team lead creates their first project, show a single inline prompt to invite a teammate (pre-filling a suggested message). Smallest reversible test: ship behind a flag to half of new trials for two weeks and compare within-48h invite rate. No new tooling needed.

apease.notes: Directly targets the dominant opportunity_physical barrier; fits the one-engineer, in-app-messaging envelope.

interventionCandidates.barrier: No invite prompt at the first-project moment, so setup ends solo
interventionCandidates.title: Post-setup email nudge to add the team
interventionCandidates.description: If no teammate is invited within 24h of first project creation, send one lifecycle email showing what unlocks when the team joins. Reversible; measured against the invite prompt as a lighter-weight alternative.

apease.notes: FLAG: coordinate with lifecycle email cadence to avoid over-mailing new trials.

interventionCandidates.barrier: Lost imported cards erode trust right after migration
interventionCandidates.title: Post-import 'here's what we imported' summary
interventionCandidates.description: Immediately after a spreadsheet or Trello import, show a summary of exactly what landed and where, with a link straight to it. Smallest test: add the summary screen for imports only and track repeat 'where are my cards' tickets.

apease.notes: Targets the capability_psychological trust barrier at migration.

interventionCandidates.barrier: Nothing makes returning in week one feel natural
interventionCandidates.title: Single week-one 'first win' return nudge
interventionCandidates.description: One reminder, anchored to a concrete first win (e.g. a teammate reacted to your board), pulling the lead back within 48h. Capped at one message; measured against opt-outs.

interventionCandidates.barrier: Single-player setup removes any social proof to collaborate
interventionCandidates.title: Auto-add all imported email addresses as teammates
interventionCandidates.description: Automatically create accounts for every email found in imported spreadsheets/Trello boards and email them that they've been added.

apease.notes: FAIL on Acceptability: provisioning and emailing people without consent risks spam complaints and data-protection breaches. Parked regardless of score.

faq.q: Won't an invite prompt annoy solo users who genuinely want to try it alone?
faq.a: It's a single, dismissible prompt at one moment (first project), and 'try it solo first' is a known request — so we make inviting easy, not mandatory, and measure dismissals.

faq.q: Is the import summary worth building before we've confirmed cards are actually lost?
faq.a: The support-ticket audit in Leverage will confirm frequency first; the summary screen is a small, reversible test we only scale if the audit supports it.

gapLog.content: Resource envelope taken as one PM at ~30% and one engineer at ~50% for 6 weeks; confirm before committing to all four tests.
Success threshold for the week-one return nudge depends on the week-one engagement metric that is not yet instrumented.
Legal/DPO review required before any auto-provisioning of imported email addresses (parked idea).
